headlines.title: After Apple, India’s smartphone manufacturing boom enters new phase with Vivo JV
headlines.author: Jagmeet Singh
headlines.excerpt: Vivo's joint venture could become a template for Chinese smartphone makers in India.

headlines.title: OpenAI says GPT 5.6 is the ‘preferred model’ for Microsoft Copilot 365 amid breakup chatter
headlines.author: Lucas Ropek
headlines.excerpt: OpenAI's new family of models will continue to power Microsoft's suite of workplace and productivity apps.

headlines.title: Don’t want to invest in Elon Musk? Two new ETFs explicitly exclude him
headlines.author: Kirsten Korosec
headlines.excerpt: The new exchanged-traded funds exclude companies that are founded, controlled, or led by Elon Musk. That means no SpaceX or Tesla.

headlines.title: Fidji Simo steps down from OpenAI’s no. 2 role
headlines.author: Connie Loizos
headlines.excerpt: OpenAI's No. 2 executive, Fidji Simo, is stepping down from her full-time role after her medical leave proved longer than expected — a leadership vacuum that comes at a tricky time as the company eyes a possible IPO and races to catch Anthropic in the enterprise market.

headlines.title: OpenAI launches its new family of models with GPT-5.6
headlines.author: Lucas Ropek
headlines.excerpt: OpenAI's latest family of models promises improvements across a range of areas, including cybersecurity.

headlines.title: An AI agent startup just let its agent run its $100M fundraise
headlines.author: Connie Loizos
headlines.excerpt: Lyzr, a startup that builds AI agents for enterprises, used its own AI agent to raise a $100 million round — proof, evidently, that the product actually works.

headlines.title: OpenAI is shutting down Atlas, but its AI browser ambitions are still growing
headlines.author: Rebecca Bellan
headlines.excerpt: OpenAI is sunsetting its AI-powered browser after less than a year. But it's moving some agentic browsing features to its desktop app and a Chrome extension.

headlines.title: Elon Musk praises Mythos/Fable, promises not to ‘cut off’ Anthropic
headlines.author: Julie Bort
headlines.excerpt: Should Anthropic trust Elon Musk to host its models? With about $40 billion in revenue at stake, Musk insists that the company can.

headlines.title: Can AI answer the $3 trillion question?
headlines.author: Tim Fernholz
headlines.excerpt: The AI ROI debate has returned and the numbers are even bigger, as are, perhaps, the consequences.

headlines.title: Meta enters the crowded AI coding battle with Muse Spark 1.1
headlines.author: Lucas Ropek
headlines.excerpt: Meta's pitch to users is Spark's ability to handle large agentic workloads, fix bugs, and help with large code migrations — the kind of automation that enterprises are increasingly turning to AI companies to provide.

headlines.title: Charles Hudson shares the common mistakes he’s seen after investing in 500+ startups
headlines.author: Maggie Nye
headlines.excerpt: In this week’s episode of Build Mode, Isabelle Johannessen talks with Precursor Ventures' Charles Hudson about the headwinds facing early-stage founders today and the most common mistakes founders should avoid in order to get funded.

headlines.title: New York Times says OpenAI hid evidence in ChatGPT copyright trial
headlines.author: Rebecca Bellan
headlines.excerpt: News publishers say OpenAI hid tools and datasets that could identify copyrighted journalism in ChatGPT outputs, escalating their lawsuit with a new motion for sanctions.

headlines.title: Slate Auto teams up with Crayola to color its EV truck
headlines.author: Kirsten Korosec
headlines.excerpt: Slate has an answer for owners who have always want to drive a truck with bright crayon colors.

headlines.title: FanDuel sent a video from star athlete Bryce Harper to a customer with a gambling problem
headlines.author: Amanda Silberling
headlines.excerpt: The video call highlights the murky relationship between professional athletes and gambling apps.

headlines.title: Mercor is in talks for a $20B valuation
headlines.author: Dominic-Madori Davis
headlines.excerpt: A new $20 billion valuation would be a giant step up from the $10 billion valuation it reached in October.

headlines.title: Google will now disclose which ads are made with AI
headlines.author: Sarah Perez
headlines.excerpt: While Google prohibits misleading and deceptive ads, an ad can still leverage AI to create some type of synthetic or digitally altered content. Until now, that's something Google only required election ads to disclose.

headlines.title: Paris-based AI voice startup Gradium raises $100M seed, backed by Nvidia
headlines.author: Julie Bort
headlines.excerpt: The company is using the cash to open an office in the Bay Area and compete for talent there, "strengthening its position at the heart of the world's leading AI ecosystem."

headlines.title: How did the government decide OpenAI’s frontier model was safe to release?
headlines.author: Tim Fernholz
headlines.excerpt: "Exactly what that dialog looked like between the government and Anthropic and OpenAI is unclear."

headlines.title: Instagram users: Here’s how to stop Meta’s AI from using your photos
headlines.author: Lauren Forristal
headlines.excerpt: Muse Image allows users to generate AI images using photos from public Instagram accounts. As long as a person's profile is public, another user can tag that account and use their images as part of an AI-generated creation.

headlines.title: Meta’s new AI chips will begin production in September
headlines.author: Ram Iyer
headlines.excerpt: The company is taking a modular approach to designing these chips, anticipating that their needs will change as AI evolves rapidly by the time the chips are in production.
